column1: # One row per vendored standard. Read by check-standards-freshness.sh.
# The canary is an exact phrase from the vendored text that must still be present on the
# live page. If it disappears, the standard has changed under us and the file is stale.
# A non-200 status means the document may have been withdrawn, which is how 24 CFR 109 died.

column4: The page has indexable content
Blocks of text that list cities and regions that a web page is trying to rank for
Items that are missing required properties are not eligible for rich results
only recommended for sites that capture reviews about other local businesses
has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1
Web pages have titles that describe topic or purpose
The default human language of each web page can be programmatically determined
elements have complete start and end tags
satisfies all the Level A and Level AA success criteria
reasonably conspicuous and located on or adjacent to the image
Websites owned, controlled, and/or maintained by the soliciting real estate licensee
indicates any preference, limitation or discrimination
The rules MUST be accessible in a file named "/robots.txt" (all lowercase)
shall conspicuously post its privacy policy on its Web site
bearing the signature of the person called that clearly authorizes the seller
Mark links that are advertisements or paid placements
must have no more than 50,000 URLs
minimum of 8 and a maximum of 128 hexadecimal characters
OAI-SearchBot is used to surface websites in search results
The REQUIRED "max-age" directive specifies the number of seconds
RENDERED:look for the heading "Bing Webmaster Guidelines" and the abuse list
RESCINDED:withdrawn from the CFR on 1 May 1996 by FR-4029-F-01
